item.title: Emerging Operations and Logistics in Platform-Based Digital Economies
item.content:encoded:
This special issue marks Omega's 55th anniversary and focuses on operational and logistics challenges arising from the expansion of platform-based digital economies. The issue seeks research that examines how traditional operations and logistics frameworks must evolve to address the unique demands of platform-driven business models.

Appel publié par Omega. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Platform-based digital economies
  • Operations management
  • Logistics
  • Digital business models
  • Platform economics
